modeling_prompt: Single full-body character of [NAME] at [AGE] in [YEAR], [DISTINCT FACE AND HAIR], [DATE-APPROPRIATE CLOTHES]. Human proportions, sculpted readable face, broad flat unlit albedo colors with no baked shadows or highlights, no photographic pores or fabric weave. Neutral front view, relaxed symmetric A-pose with arms30 degrees from torso, hands open and fingers separated, legs apart, every fingertip and shoe entirely in frame with generous margins. Plain background, no held props, no scenery, no text. Separate coat tails or skirt panels from legs and separate hands from sleeves. Supply front side back and three-quarter references with matching anatomy and outfit. Final toon bands and warm brown outlines will be applied in-engine.
